options: A short throttle pulse on all motors
A 10-degree angle step
White noise at the mixer input
A sine wave with rising frequency
questions.explain: The frequency rises from f₀ to f₁ — energy at every frequency in the range, one after another.

It can't be computed in NumPy

That the estimate at these frequencies is perfectly linear
That the delay is zero
Motors overheating in flight
questions.explain: The output is no longer explained linearly by the input — don't trust the estimate at these frequencies.
